name: Yipei Niu
description: Yipei Niu — research and publications in computer systems, serverless computing, distributed systems, and multi-agent reinforcement learning.
about: My research interests span computer systems and AI, including scalable large language model training, reinforcement learning, and multi-agent systems. I also study serverless and hybrid cloud computing, resource management, and networked systems.
I received my Ph.D. in Computer Architecture from Huazhong University of Science and Technology in June 2023, advised by Prof. Fangming Liu.
